content: {"praised":["Cornered, Desperate, Armored Car Robbery, Phenix City Story are fairly good noirish films","The set showcases a range of noir styles from studio lighting to semi-documentary","Controlled lighting and studio sets give a classic 1940s noir feel","The films cover diverse themes and tones typical of 1940s-1950s noir"],"criticized":["Less than half of the films are true film noir","Some films have ridiculous storylines and poor pacing","The Phenix City Story misrepresents military reality","Overall quality is mediocre compared to earlier volumes"]}
